snippet.title: Box 3 Was the Key 📦 Riddle #4 Answer + Riddle #5: Three Switches, One Door #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's answer: pick from box 3, the one labelled MIXED. Its label is wrong, so it holds only one kind of fruit. Pull out an apple and it's the apples box. The box labelled ORANGES can't be oranges, so it's the mixed box, and the last box (labelled APPLES) is oranges. Same logic the other way round if you pull an orange.

Riddle #5: Three light switches on a wall. Only one of them turns on a lamp in another room, behind a closed door. Person 1 says you can flip the switches as many times as you like, but you may open that door only ONCE. No helpers, no cameras, one visit. How do you find the right switch?

Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. 🌅
